### Frozen Fibrin Sealant Kit (FIB-F04) ###
Supplier: SUP-001
Storage: Keep frozen at -22 to -4°F (-30 to -20°C). Shipper must hold frozen on arrival. Record temperatures at handoff.
Excursion: any reading above -4°F (-20°C) means the kit is thawing. Do not refreeze. Quarantine the lot until QA disposition.
Allowance: none. Thawed kit is not released for use without QA sign-off.
Escalation Policy (embedded): Zimmer Biotech | Escalation SOP (ZB-SUP-2041)
Tier 1 (delay <24h, reading at or below -4°F): logistics@zimmerbio.com; log dry-ice recharge.
Tier 2 (any reading above -4°F, or delay >24h): qa@zimmerbio.com; director.supply@zimmerbio.com; quarantine lot.
Tier 3 (reading above 14°F / -10°C, or a STAT surgery at risk): vp.ops@zimmerbio.com | +1-312-555-0100.
SLA: Acknowledge 1h; quarantine decision 4h; CAPA 24h.

### Cardiac Stent Kit (coated) (STENT-C13) ###
Supplier: SUP-002
Storage: Store at 59–77°F (15–25°C). Drug-eluting coating: heat can change drug dose and coating integrity. Record temperatures at handoff.
Excursion: any reading above 77°F (25°C) is a heat excursion. Readings below 59°F are logged as range deviations for QA review.
Allowance: none without a written QA assessment.
Escalation Policy (embedded): MedPro Devices | SLA (MP-SLA-007)
On-time ≥98%. Any reading above 77°F is a non-conformance.
Tier 1 (delay <12h, reading in range): shipping@medpro.com
Tier 2 (reading 78–86°F, or delay >12h): operations@medpro.com; hold kit at destination until QA release.
Tier 3 (reading above 86°F, or STAT surgery at risk): ceo.office@medpro.com.
Weather delay >12h: reroute through an alternate hub.
SLA: Acknowledge 1h; disposition 24h.

### Drug-Coated Balloon Catheter (paclitaxel) (CATH-B08) ###
Supplier: SUP-003
Storage: Ambient, 59–86°F (15–30°C). Keep out of direct sun and heated cargo areas. Record temperatures at handoff.
Excursion: any reading above 86°F (30°C) is a heat excursion. Paclitaxel coating degrades with heat. Isolate the lot.
Allowance: none. Readings below 59°F are logged and reviewed by QA.
Escalation Policy (embedded): Ortho Dynamics | OD-QA-115
L1 (reading 87–90°F, or delay <24h): warehouse.alerts@orthodynamics.com (≤2h)
L2 (reading above 90°F, or delay >24h): dist.ops@orthodynamics.com (≤4h)
L3 (STAT surgery at risk): cmo.office@orthodynamics.com (≤8h)
Temp excursion → isolate lot; notify QA.

### Refrigerated Thrombin Hemostat (THRM-R04) ###
Supplier: SUP-004
Storage: Refrigerate at 36–46°F (2–8°C). Do not freeze. Record temperatures at handoff.
Excursion: below 36°F or above 46°F. Readings 47–50°F need QA review. Readings below 32°F (freezing) or above 50°F mean rejection.
Allowance: none without QA review.
Escalation Policy (embedded): CardioNova | CN-COLD-003
Tier 1 (delay <24h, reading in range): supply@cardionova.com
Tier 2 (reading outside 36–46°F, or delay >24h): qa@cardionova.com
Tier 3 (freezing below 32°F, reading above 50°F, or STAT surgery at risk): compliance@cardionova.com
SLA: QA review within 24h.

### Bioprosthetic Aortic Valve (bovine tissue) (VALVE-E11) ###
Supplier: SUP-005
Storage: Room temperature, 50–77°F (10–25°C), in the shipper. Never freeze. Keep out of direct sun. Record temperatures at handoff.
Freeze events: any reading below 32°F (0°C) is a freeze event. Quarantine the valve at once. No release without ValveX written assessment.
Minor (45–49.9°F or 77.1–80°F): log; QA notified next business day.
Moderate (32–44.9°F or 80.1–86°F): notify QA same shift; hold at destination; QA disposition within 24h.
Critical (below 32°F or above 86°F): isolate and escalate to qa.supervisor@valvex.com and compliance@valvex.com immediately.
Contacts: qa.supervisor@valvex.com; compliance@valvex.com
SLA: Acknowledge 2h; freeze quarantine within 1h.

### Frozen Bone Allograft (cryopreserved) (BONE-A17) ###
Supplier: SUP-009
Storage: Keep at or below -40°F (-40°C). Allowed range -112 to -40°F (-80 to -40°C). Shipper hold time must cover ETA plus 12h. Record temperatures at handoff.
Excursion: any reading above -40°F (-40°C) is a warming excursion. Do not refreeze. Quarantine the lot.
Escalation Policy (embedded): OrthoCore | Supplier Playbook
Tier 1 (delay <24h, reading at or below -40°F): ops@orthocore.com
Tier 2 (any reading above -40°F, or delay >24h): qa@orthocore.com; quarantine lot.
Tier 3 (reading above -22°F, or STAT surgery at risk): qa@orthocore.com; request supplier executive review.
